title: Compression Does Not End at Selection: Post-Selection Positional Geometry for Sparse KV Caches
abstract: arXiv:2610.21126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse KV compression reduces long-context inference costs by retaining selected historical states, yet these states typically keep their coordinates from the full history. Under Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), gaps left by evicted tokens continue to affect query-key matching, potentially limiting the use of retained evidence. We study post-selection positional geometry on a fixed selector-produced cache, examining how positional organization affects the use of retained information and which coordinate and continuation rules improve answer quality. To reorganize this geometry, we propose RoPERelay, which assigns compact, order-preserving RoPE coordinates, relocates cached key phases through inverse rotation and re-rotation, and synchronizes the current query and subsequent generation. translated_title: 压缩不止于选择：稀疏 KV 缓存的选择后位置几何
translated_abstract: 稀疏 KV 压缩通过保留被选中的历史状态来降低长上下文推理的成本，然而这些状态通常仍保留其在完整历史中的原始坐标。在旋转位置编码下，被驱逐 token 留下的间隙会持续影响查询-键匹配，可能限制对已保留证据的利用。我们在由选择器生成、内容固定的缓存上研究选择后的位置几何，考察位置组织方式如何影响保留信息的使用，以及哪些坐标分配与延续规则能够提升答案质量。为重组这种几何结构，我们提出 RoPERelay：它分配紧凑且保序的 RoPE 坐标，通过逆旋转与再旋转重新定位缓存键的相位，并同步当前查询与后续生成。该方法复用现有的 K/V，无需重新选择、无需历史重新预填充，也无需额外的缓存预算。在跨越两个模型、六种稀疏……的 36 项对比实验中（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出 RoPERelay，通过为稀疏 KV 缓存重新分配紧凑保序的 RoPE 坐标并以逆旋转-再旋转方式重定位键相位，消除被驱逐 token 留下的位置间隙对查询-键匹配的干扰，在不增加缓存预算的前提下提升长上下文推理质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes RoPERelay, which reassigns compact, order-preserving RoPE coordinates and relocates cached key phases via inverse and re-rotation to remove positional gaps left by evicted tokens in sparse KV caches, improving long-context inference quality without any extra cache budget.
